# Windows package

`DedupeLight-win-x64.zip` contains the standalone 64-bit Windows executable and brief usage instructions.

1. Download the ZIP.
2. Extract it to a normal folder.
3. Run `DedupeLight.exe`.

SHA-256: `7763D763CAC4FC22DB66EA2F145861D5B49BF296FEF701D410CEBA9AE67EE494`

This package is generated from the source in the repository root. The same executable is also produced by the GitHub Actions workflow after each push to `main`.
